Water Dries.
The Evidence Goes With It.
You always have final say on any settlement
Water losses are highly time sensitive. If the water isn't measured, it dries, and mold begins to grow.
Moisture mapping, room by room, to document how far the water traveled.
Plumbing failure analysis to establish proximate cause, because sudden and accidental is covered and gradual usually isn't.
Tear out scope: drywall, insulation, flooring, cabinets, subfloor.
Firefighting water: after a fire, the water damage is its own line on the claim.
Many policies cap mold remediation at a low amount.
One we reviewed capped it at $7,500. That's why a delayed water claim so often becomes a mold claim.
Call Before the Carrier Sets the Narrative.
Your insurance company has an adjuster protecting their interests. You have the right to one too.
Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Pacific
